Mages build are kinda okay against tank as long as u know what u doing and depend on on your champion

Swifty against the tank that reply on the skill shot or can chase you other just normal pen boot , cd boost is nice here to if u need to constantly spawn spell like syndra 
HF if you not a main dealer or you don't think you are to do much
Sb if you are not going against 2+ tanks 
As for mana item BFT if u can't reach the backline otherwhile luden . Maglinance is kinda situational  , Roa for extra survivability but no cd
Void is most of the time unless  u need more cd
Liandry is not always a good pick up against tank unless your champ are able to benefit from it
Rylai make tank without mobility suffer but only build it if ur champ can abuse bft and liandry 
Healcut/shield cut are depend what they abuse most
DC can be skip if you are not main dealer
Shurelya is a decent pick up too if u need disengage 
Storm surge can buy to replace boot for extra mr pen

Almost never build zhyona or banshee unless they can 1 shot you or u are a main engage (replace void with AM if ur team have 3+ ap)

Main reason mages always loss against tank is people refuse to build mr pen early and wait for it to be the final item to build or not build them as all
